sloka: सा सीता श्वशुरं श्रुत्वा स्वर्गलोकगतं नृपम् ।नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामशकन्नेक्षितुं पतिम् ॥ २.१०२.१८॥
transliteration: sā sītā śvaśuraṁ śrutvā svargalokagataṁ nṛpam ।netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāmaśakannekṣituṁ patim ॥ 2.102.18॥

translations.english: On hearing that her fatherinlaw, king Dasaratha, had attained heaven, Sita, her eyes filled with tears could not look at her husband in the face.
